title: Gold climbs as traders add bets on Federal Reserve rate cuts
summary: Softer inflation data pushed Treasury yields lower and increased expectations for policy easing.
content: Lower real rates tend to reduce the opportunity cost of holding bullion.

title: Gold falls after hawkish Fed remarks lift the dollar
summary: Officials said inflation remains too high and markets cut near-term easing expectations.
content: The dollar index rose and yields moved higher after the remarks.

title: Gold retreats as hotter CPI revives rate-hike concern
summary: Consumer inflation surprised to the upside, pressuring rate-sensitive assets.
content: Higher-for-longer policy expectations weighed on non-yielding gold.

title: Gold rallies after cooler CPI weakens dollar and yields
summary: Inflation slowed more than economists expected, supporting demand for bullion.
content: Investors bought gold as real-rate expectations declined.

title: Gold gains as Middle East conflict risk spurs safe-haven demand
summary: Investors moved into defensive assets after reports of escalating regional tensions.
content: Safe-haven flows supported bullion despite a steady dollar.

title: Gold slips as ceasefire hopes reduce safe-haven demand
summary: Diplomatic progress eased geopolitical risk and reduced defensive flows.
content: Bullion gave back part of the prior session's risk-premium rally.

title: Gold supported by fresh central bank buying reports
summary: Reserve managers continued to add bullion holdings according to monthly data.
content: Persistent official-sector demand is a supportive structural signal for gold.

title: Gold pressured as Treasury yields and dollar strengthen
summary: The metal lost ground while bond yields climbed across the curve.
content: A stronger dollar made bullion more expensive for non-dollar buyers.

title: Gold edges lower as ETF outflows show softer investor demand
summary: Exchange-traded funds backed by bullion reported another week of redemptions.
content: The outflows signaled weaker investment appetite for gold.

title: Gold rises as bullion ETFs attract renewed inflows
summary: Fund flows turned positive as investors increased exposure to precious metals.
content: Improved ETF demand helped absorb selling pressure from a firmer dollar.

title: Gold holds steady before FOMC minutes
summary: Bullion stayed in a narrow range as traders waited for policy guidance.
content: The market showed limited conviction ahead of the release.

title: Gold little changed as safe-haven bids offset a stronger dollar
summary: Geopolitical concerns supported demand, while currency strength capped gains.
content: The competing drivers left bullion near unchanged levels.
